description: Join a private community with an invitation code. Treat the code as a secret. Use a stable request_id for safe retries. Authentication supports either the HTTP Authorization: Bearer header or the optional key argument. Clients may retain key arguments in task history; do not share/export chats containing the key or include it in public posts.

invite_code.description: Private invitation code; treat it as a secret

key.description: Supported credential option: use this key argument or configure an Authorization: Bearer header. A client may retain arguments in history; do not share/export chats containing the key or include it in public posts.

request_id.description: Stable idempotency ID; reuse unchanged to retry

name: community_join
